target.title: fix(agent): check updateSessionEntry return value for pendingFinalDelivery write
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `pendingFinalDelivery` state written via `updateSessionEntry` silently discards write failures. If the store write fails (IO error, disk full, permission denied), the delivery state is lost and restart recovery reads stale state — the reply is never re-sent.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added `requireWriteSuccess: true` to the `updateSessionEntry` options for the `pendingFinalDelivery` write. This is a durable state write where silent failure would cause data loss. The `requireWriteSuccess` option makes the store throw on write failure instead of returning null, so the caller (`runReplyAgent`) properly fails when this critical metadata cannot be persisted. This is the same pattern used in 4 other call sites for critical state writes: `dashboard-session-title.ts:109`, `session-lifecycle-state.ts:285`, `main-session-restart-recovery.ts:217`, `state-migrations.ts:5693`.

## User Impact

None in normal operation. On store write failure, the agent run now throws instead of silently losing pending delivery state.

## Evidence

- **Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, branch `fix/check-pending-delivery-write`
- **Existing tests**:

  ```console
  $ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.test.ts
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  4 passed (4)
  ```

- **Focused failure-injection proof** (`pending-final-delivery.store-write-failure.test.ts`): Injects an ENOENT write failure into the underlying `writeTextAtomic` call and verifies that `updateSessionEntry` with `requireWriteSuccess: true` propagates the error instead of silently swallowing it:

  ```console
  $ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.store-write-failure.test.ts
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  1 passed (1)
  ```

  The test:
  1. Creates a real session store with an existing entry
  2. Mocks `writeTextAtomic` to reject with an ENOENT error
  3. Calls `updateSessionEntry` with `requireWriteSuccess: true` and the same arguments as the pending-final-delivery write path
  4. Asserts the promise rejects with the injected error — proving the write failure is no longer silently discarded

- **Observed result after fix**: All tests pass. The failure-injection test proves the `requireWriteSuccess: true` option converts a silent store write failure into a thrown error at the `updateSessionEntry` level.

## Regression Test Plan

```console
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.test.ts
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.store-write-failure.test.ts
```

---

AI-assisted.
